title: Oceania Road Championships: Individual Time Trial
subtitle: Flat Out in McLaren Vale
location: Main Road, McLaren Flat (McLaren Vale), SA
description: One 17.3 km lap that makes riders keep rebuilding speed over a rolling climb, then hit a fast descent and short pinches on the way home. U19, U23 and Elite riders from Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific race the clock for the Oceania time trial titles. This is also the opening day of the Hertz ProVelo Super League Round 1 (SA Kick It). Spectator tip: set up near the start/finish on Main Road, McLaren Flat, to see every rider leave the ramp and sprint home.

title: Oceania Road Championships: Road Race
subtitle: Oceania Glory Decided in McLaren Vale
location: McLaren Vale, SA (Echelon Club Hub & Vineyard Circuit)
description: Racing among the McLaren Vale vineyards, with UCI ranking points and the Oceania Champion's jersey on the line just days before the Santos Tour Down Under. Each 21.3 km lap has a testing climb and a decisive gravel sector on Pennys Hill Road that will split the bunch, and riders have no team radios or support to lean on. Spectator hub: The Echelon Club at the start/finish, with a live DJ, food trucks, bars, a big screen and a family-friendly race atmosphere. This is also Round 1 of the Hertz ProVelo Super League (SA Kick It).

highlights.label: Gravel Sector
highlights.detail: 3.6 km unpaved climb on Pennys Hill Road (km 3.9–7.4 of each lap)

highlights.label: Echelon Club Hub (Food, Drinks & Big Screen)
